description.en: Use Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs to write, review, and refactor React and Next.js code. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel React Best Practices，辅助编写、审查和重构 React 与 Next.js 代码。围绕数据请求、包体积、渲染和状态更新寻找改进方向，结合具体页面与交互，优先处理有实际影响的性能问题。

en: Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs
zh: Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs

title.en: Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use Vercel React Best Practices by Vercel Labs to write, review, and refactor React and Next.js code. Explore guidance for data fetching, bundle loading, rendering, and state updates, then focus your agent on the changes most relevant to the page or interaction you want to improve.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel React Best Practices，辅助编写、审查和重构 React 与 Next.js 代码。围绕数据请求、包体积、渲染和状态更新寻找改进方向，结合具体页面与交互，优先处理有实际影响的性能问题。

summary.en: The source organizes React and Next.js performance rules into eight impact-ranked categories. That makes it useful for a focused review of fetching, bundles, server rendering, client state, and re-renders—not a substitute for profiling a real page.
summary.zh: 原始规则按影响程度分成八类，覆盖请求、包体积、服务端渲染、客户端数据和重渲染。适合做有重点的代码审查，但不能替代真实页面的性能测量。

how.zh: 如何优化 React 性能

howDescription.en: A React review needs a reproducible route or interaction before optimization begins. The steps below connect relevant performance rules with a bounded code change and a repeat of the same user path, so the result can be compared with the starting measurements.
howDescription.zh: 性能优化需要前后可比较的起点。先将规则对应到可复现路由或交互，只修改已选路径，再重复相同用户操作，同时检查功能行为和测量结果，判断改动是否真正有效。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel React Best Practices Skill
title.zh: Vercel React Best Practices Skill的使用场景

description.en: Request waterfalls, large client bundles, and repeated rendering need different evidence. Explore how Vercel React Best Practices relates loading traces, import paths, and interaction profiles to focused changes that can be measured again.
description.zh: 请求瀑布、包体积和重复渲染需要不同证据。了解 Vercel React Best Practices 如何结合加载、导入与交互分析，选择可通过前后测量核验的优化方向。

title.en: A page loads data in a chain

description.en: When a page loads data through a chain of requests, inspect its loading code, dependency relationships, and timing traces together. Check whether independent requests can run in parallel or an await can move into the branch that needs it. Compare the same loading path before and after a focused change.
description.zh: 页面数据请求串行等待时，将加载代码、请求依赖和耗时记录放在一起检查。判断独立请求能否并行，以及 await 是否可以移到真正需要它的分支。修改后沿相同加载路径比较表现，用前后测量确认调整是否减少了不必要的等待。

title.en: A client component ships too much code
title.zh: 客户端组件加载过多代码

description.en: A large client bundle calls for examining entry points, import paths, and bundle analysis before adding another loading indicator. Trace broad imports, heavy modules, and third-party scripts to find what is being shipped. Compare bundle results after targeted splitting or deferred loading rather than assuming every dependency needs the same treatment.
description.zh: 客户端代码体积过大时，先分析入口、导入路径和包体积，而不是立即增加加载提示。沿聚合导入、重型模块与第三方脚本定位实际负担，再评估拆包或延迟加载。调整后比较包分析结果，判断哪些依赖确实需要采用不同加载方式。

description.en: Expensive work during frequent updates needs interaction recordings and profiling evidence. Inspect state placement, derived values, and re-render triggers before applying memoization throughout the component tree. Make a targeted adjustment, then repeat the original interaction to check both performance and behavior.
description.zh: 组件频繁更新并重复执行高开销工作时，先查看交互记录和性能分析。检查状态位置、派生值与重新渲染的触发原因，再决定局部优化方式，避免到处添加记忆化。修改后复现原交互，同时核对性能变化和行为是否正确。

title.zh: 检查重复的服务端工作

description.en: A route can repeat data preparation or computation even when the visible page renders correctly. Inspect the server-side path and request boundaries to identify where work is duplicated, then compare a focused reuse or scheduling change with the original behavior. Preserve freshness and access requirements, and measure the same request before treating less repeated work as a verified improvement.
description.zh: 页面显示正确时，路由内部也可能重复准备数据或计算。沿服务端路径与请求边界定位重复位置，再将限定的复用或调度调整与原行为比较。保留时效和访问要求，并使用相同请求测量，不能只看到工作次数减少就认定优化已经有效。

prompt.en: Review this Next.js product page for request waterfalls and unnecessary client-side JavaScript. Rank the fixes and show the exact files.
prompt.zh: 检查这个 Next.js 产品页有没有请求瀑布和不必要的客户端 JavaScript，按影响排序并指出具体文件。

description.en: Identify the route or interaction and provide a reproducible symptom. Include a trace, network timing, or bundle report when available.
description.zh: 指定路由或交互，说明可复现的性能现象。有追踪、网络时序或包体积报告时，一并交给 Agent。

description.en: Ask the agent to inspect the code using the matching impact-ranked categories. Read the proposed changes before applying them to the selected path.
description.zh: 让 Agent 按匹配的规则类别检查代码，并参考影响排序确定重点。核对建议后，再修改选定路径。

description.en: Repeat the same user path after the change. Check correctness alongside loading, interaction, or bundle measurements.
description.zh: 修改后重复同一条用户路径。同时检查功能正确性，以及加载、交互或包体积指标。

question.en: Is Vercel React Best Practices only for Next.js?
question.zh: Vercel React Best Practices 只能用于 Next.js 吗？

answer.en: No. Many rules concern React generally, while some sections address Next.js server rendering and routing. Apply only the rules that match your stack.
answer.zh: 不是。许多规则适用于 React 通用代码，部分章节针对 Next.js 服务端渲染和路由；只应用与当前技术栈匹配的规则。

question.en: Does it rewrite the whole app?
question.zh: 它会重写整个应用吗？

answer.en: It is a set of instructions for an agent, not an autonomous refactoring service. Scope the request to the route or component you want reviewed.
answer.zh: 它是给 Agent 的指令集，不是自动重构服务。应明确要审查的路由或组件。

question.en: How do I know a recommendation helped?
question.zh: 如何知道建议真的有效？

answer.en: Measure the same user path before and after. A rule match is a reason to investigate, not proof of a faster page.
answer.zh: 对同一用户路径做前后测量。命中规则代表值得调查，不等于页面已经变快。

question.en: Where are the original rules?
question.zh: 原始规则在哪里？

answer.en: The source SKILL.md links individual rule files in Vercel Labs' agent-skills repository; this page links the original source.
answer.zh: 原始 SKILL.md 位于 Vercel Labs 的 agent-skills 仓库，并指向各条规则文件；本页可直接打开来源。

question.en: Which performance issue should I investigate first?
question.zh: 应该先排查哪一种性能问题？

answer.en: Start with a measured user-visible bottleneck, such as a request waterfall or slow interaction. Use the impact ranking to choose an investigation, then compare the same scenario before and after the change.
answer.zh: 先选一个有测量依据、用户能感知的问题，例如请求瀑布或交互延迟，再参考规则的影响排序定位原因，并在相同场景下比较修改前后。

question.en: Can a rule be applied on either side of a server/client boundary?
question.zh: 服务端与客户端可以套用相同规则吗？

answer.en: Check where the code executes before changing data fetching or state. A server-rendering recommendation and a client interaction recommendation solve different problems, even when both involve the same component.
answer.zh: 修改请求或状态逻辑前先确认代码在哪里执行。服务端渲染与客户端交互的优化目标不同，涉及同一个组件也不能直接互换做法。

question.en: What should I provide for a useful performance review?
question.zh: 开始性能审查前需要提供什么？

answer.en: Provide the route or component files, your React and Next.js versions, a reproducible symptom, and any available traces or bundle reports. Those inputs help the agent choose relevant rules and give you a baseline for checking the change.
answer.zh: 提供路由或组件文件、React 与 Next.js 版本、可复现的现象，以及已有追踪或包体积报告。这些信息能帮助 Agent 选择适用规则，并为修改后的对比提供基线。

cardDescription.en: Review React and Next.js code against prioritized rules for data fetching, bundle size, rendering, and runtime performance.
cardDescription.zh: 按优先级审查 React 与 Next.js 代码，检查数据请求、包体积、渲染与运行性能。

en.title: About Vercel React Best Practices
paragraphs: Vercel React Best Practices is an Agent Skill published in Vercel Labs’ agent-skills repository for reviewing React and Next.js performance patterns. Its rules cover request waterfalls, bundle loading, server work, client fetching, re-renders, rendering, JavaScript cost, and advanced patterns. The impact ranking helps an agent decide which code paths deserve attention first. Individual rule files provide explanations and implementation examples for a focused change. Give the agent the relevant route or component and the behavior you want to improve; use measurements from your project to judge the result. Installing the Skill adds guidance to the agent, while code changes and performance checks take place in your application.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel React Best Practices
paragraphs: Vercel React Best Practices 是 Vercel Labs 在 agent-skills 仓库中发布的 Agent Skill，为 React 与 Next.js 代码提供按影响程度排序的性能规则。内容涵盖请求瀑布、包体积、服务端工作、客户端数据获取、重渲染、渲染过程与 JavaScript 开销，帮助 Agent 决定先检查哪些路径。各条规则附有解释与实现示例，适合围绕具体路由或组件开展审查和重构。使用时应说明待改进的页面、交互与现有表现，再把建议对应到代码。安装 Skill 获得的是操作指引；修改是否有效，需要通过项目中的行为验证和前后测量来判断。

title.en: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs to design clearer React component APIs. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel Composition Patterns，梳理 React 组件 API 与共享状态。针对不断增加的布尔属性、复杂变体和组件库扩展需求，探索复合组件、Provider 与明确变体，让组件结构更贴近实际调用方式。

en: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs
zh: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs

title.en: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use Vercel Composition Patterns by Vercel Labs to design clearer React component APIs. Review components with growing boolean props, coordinate shared state through providers, and introduce compound components or explicit variants that fit the way your application and component library are actually used.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel Composition Patterns，梳理 React 组件 API 与共享状态。针对不断增加的布尔属性、复杂变体和组件库扩展需求，探索复合组件、Provider 与明确变体，让组件结构更贴近实际调用方式。

summary.en: The source favors compound components and provider-owned state over prop combinations that multiply. It is most useful while designing a component library or untangling a component whose API is hard to reason about.
summary.zh: 原始规则主张用复合组件和 Provider 管理状态，而非让属性组合无限增加。它适合设计组件库，或梳理 API 已经难以理解的组件。

how.en: How to Design React Component APIs
how.zh: 如何设计 React 组件 API

howDescription.en: Composition changes should be tested against the callers that depend on the current API. Inspect ambiguous props and state ownership, then migrate representative uses before expanding the change. Existing interactions provide the evidence for whether the new interface preserves behavior.
howDescription.zh: 新的组合接口能否成立，需要由真实调用方验证。找出模糊属性和状态归属后，先迁移常见及边缘用法，确认原有交互仍然正确，再决定扩大迁移范围。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel Composition Patterns Skill
title.zh: Vercel Composition Patterns Skill的使用场景

description.en: Boolean-heavy controls, sibling state, and flexible component libraries create different API problems. Compare how Vercel Composition Patterns uses named compositions, provider boundaries, and explicit variants while preserving the behavior existing callers rely on.
description.zh: 布尔属性、共享状态和布局扩展对应不同接口问题。了解 Vercel Composition Patterns 如何通过具名组合及明确变体收敛接口，并保留已有行为。

title.en: A dialog has too many boolean modes

description.en: A dialog with many boolean modes can hide behavior behind combinations of props. Inspect its confirm/edit callers and the modes that must remain, then replace ambiguous combinations with named compositions visible at the call site. Provide migration examples and check existing modes against the new API before removing the old one.
description.zh: 对话框存在大量布尔模式时，行为容易隐藏在属性组合中。检查确认、编辑等调用方及必须保留的模式，将难以理解的组合改为调用位置可见的具名组合。提供迁移样例，并核对原有模式，再决定如何替换旧接口。

title.en: Sibling controls need the same state
title.zh: 兄弟控件需要共享状态

description.en: Sibling controls that share state and events may be burdened by long prop chains. Trace the existing paths and place the relevant state and actions behind a provider boundary when appropriate. Update the callers around that explicit API so shared behavior stays clear without threading data through every intermediate component.
description.zh: 兄弟控件共享状态和事件时，过长的属性传递链可能增加理解成本。先梳理现有路径，再将相关状态与动作放入合适的 provider 边界，围绕明确接口更新调用方。共享行为得以保留，也不需要每个中间组件都代传数据。

title.zh: 组件库使用者需要可控的灵活性

description.en: A component library should expose the flexibility its real consumers need without requiring them to reimplement internal logic. Compare layout requirements with compound parts and explicit variants, then define a bounded composition API. Include correct and incorrect examples so consumers can distinguish supported assembly from accidental misuse.
description.zh: 组件库应满足真实使用方的布局需求，同时避免让它们重写内部逻辑。结合复合部件和明确变体，设计有边界的组合接口，并给出正确与错误样例。使用方可以据此区分受支持的拼装方式和无意中绕过组件约定的用法。

title.en: Check patterns against the React version
title.zh: 核对组合模式的 React 版本要求

description.en: A composition recommendation may depend on React APIs that differ from those used by the project. Establish the current React and framework versions before adopting version-specific guidance, then compare the affected callers and supported interfaces. Keep compatible patterns separate from proposals that require an upgrade, and validate behavior before widening the migration.
description.zh: 组合建议可能依赖与当前项目不同的 React API。采用特定版本指引前，确认 React 和框架版本，再比较受影响调用方与受支持接口。将兼容模式和需要升级的提案分开，先验证行为，避免在迁移中静默增加版本前提。

prompt.en: Refactor this Modal with six boolean props into an API that supports confirm and edit flows without surprising combinations.
prompt.zh: 把这个带六个布尔属性的 Modal 重构成能支持确认和编辑流程、又不会出现意外组合的 API。

description.en: Share the component and representative uses. Identify unclear combinations and the variations your callers actually need.
description.zh: 提供组件与代表性调用。找出含义不清的属性组合，并列出调用方真正需要的变化。

description.en: Ask the agent to propose compound parts, explicit variants, or a provider for shared state. Check React-version requirements before choosing APIs.
description.zh: 让 Agent 提议复合部件、明确变体或共享状态 Provider。选择具体 API 前先核对 React 版本要求。

description.en: Move common and edge cases to the proposed interface. Verify interactions and keep remaining callers working during migration.
description.zh: 将常见和边缘用法迁移到新接口。验证交互，并在迁移期间保持其余调用正常工作。

question.en: What are compound components?
question.zh: 什么是复合组件？

answer.en: They expose related parts under a shared component API, often with context to coordinate state, so callers can assemble the structure they need.
answer.zh: 它把相关部件放在同一套组件 API 下，通常通过上下文协调状态，让调用方按需要组合结构。

question.en: Should every boolean prop be removed?
question.zh: 所有布尔属性都要删除吗？

answer.en: No. The concern is proliferating behavior modes and unclear combinations. A simple flag can remain if it keeps the API clear.
answer.zh: 不用。问题在于行为模式膨胀和组合含义不清；如果一个简单开关依然清楚，就无需强行移除。

question.en: Will this Skill improve runtime performance?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 会提升运行性能吗？

answer.en: Its main goal is maintainable component architecture. Measure separately if performance is the reason for the refactor.
answer.zh: 它主要解决组件架构的可维护性。如果重构目的是性能提升，仍需单独测量。

question.en: Can React 18 projects use it?
question.zh: React 18 项目可以用吗？

answer.en: Yes for the general patterns; the source explicitly separates React 19-only guidance, which should not be applied to older versions.
answer.zh: 通用模式可以使用；原文单独标记了 React 19 专属建议，旧版本不应套用。

question.en: How can an existing component be migrated gradually?
question.zh: 已有组件如何逐步迁移？

answer.en: Choose one confusing combination of props and give it a clear composed alternative. Keep existing callers working while you validate the new API, rather than redesigning the whole component library at once.
answer.zh: 先挑一个难以理解的属性组合，提供语义清楚的组合方式，并保持旧调用仍可工作。验证新接口后再扩大范围，不必一次重写整个组件库。

question.en: When is shared context unnecessary?
question.zh: 什么时候不需要引入共享 Context？

answer.en: If a value is used by only one direct child, an ordinary prop may be clearer. Provider-owned state helps when several related components genuinely need a shared contract, not simply because composition is available.
answer.zh: 如果某个值只传给一个直接子组件，普通属性通常更清晰。只有多个相关组件确实需要共享状态契约时，才有必要引入 Provider。

question.en: Which files should I include in a component API review?
question.zh: 组件 API 审查应提供哪些文件？

answer.en: Include the component, its state provider if present, and several real callers. Add the React version and the combinations that are difficult to maintain, so the agent can propose an API that supports actual use.
answer.zh: 提供组件、已有状态 Provider 和几个真实调用方，并注明 React 版本及难以维护的属性组合，让 Agent 围绕实际用途设计接口。

cardDescription.en: Design clearer React component APIs using compound components, composition, and provider-managed state instead of growing prop combinations.
cardDescription.zh: 通过复合组件、组合模式与 Provider 状态管理，简化 React 组件接口和复杂属性组合。

en.title: About Vercel Composition Patterns
paragraphs: Vercel Composition Patterns is an Agent Skill for designing and refactoring reusable React components. It focuses on component APIs whose behavior has become difficult to understand as props and modes accumulate. The guidance covers compound components, provider-owned state, explicit variants, and composition through children. An agent can use these patterns to inspect existing callers, separate shared behavior from presentation, and propose a clearer interface. The source also includes React 19-specific API guidance, which needs to be checked against the project’s version. Use the Skill around a component with real call sites, and validate those uses as the API changes.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel Composition Patterns
paragraphs: Vercel Composition Patterns 是 Vercel Labs 发布的 React 组件设计与重构 Skill，重点处理属性和行为模式不断增加后难以理解的组件 API。它介绍复合组件、由 Provider 管理的共享状态、明确变体，以及通过 children 组织结构的方式，帮助 Agent 从真实调用出发，区分共享行为与界面表现，提出更清晰的接口。原始规则还包含 React 19 专属 API 建议，使用时需要对应项目版本。它适合组件库设计和已有复杂组件的整理；实施时应检查代表性调用，逐步迁移并验证交互，避免只为采用某种模式而增加抽象。

how.zh: 如何审查 React Native 界面

howDescription.en: Mobile changes need a defined screen, target platform, and interaction to improve. Use the relevant React Native rules to bound implementation, then check the same flow on representative devices rather than assuming iOS and Android behave identically.
howDescription.zh: 移动端问题必须放回具体平台与设备检查。确定页面和交互后，按相关规则限定修改，再在代表设备复查原流程；iOS 与 Android 的差异不能靠网页经验直接推断。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel React Native Skills
title.zh: Vercel React Native Skills的使用场景

description.en: Scrolling performance, delayed gestures, and platform differences need evidence from the target device. Explore how Vercel React Native Skills separates rendering, animation, and native-layout checks instead of applying web assumptions to every mobile screen.
description.zh: 滚动、手势和平台差异需要设备上的证据。了解 Vercel React Native Skills 如何检查渲染、动画与原生布局，避免直接套用网页假设。

description.en: Dropped frames during scrolling need evidence from the target device and the actual list implementation. Inspect virtualization, item rendering, callback stability, and image settings before rebuilding the screen. After addressing a demonstrated bottleneck, repeat the same scrolling interaction on the same device to assess the change.
description.zh: 滚动掉帧需要结合目标设备上的记录和真实列表实现调查。重做整个页面前，先检查虚拟化、条目渲染、回调稳定性与图片设置。处理已定位的瓶颈后，在同一设备复现相同滚动交互，判断调整是否改善表现。

description.en: A delayed gesture should be traced through its implementation and the properties being animated. Review the choice of gesture primitives and whether the animation uses compositor-friendly properties, then check the changed behavior during a continuous interaction. A single final frame cannot show whether the gesture now follows the user's movement.
description.zh: 手势反馈延迟时，沿实现方式和动画属性调查，检查手势基础能力是否合适、动画是否采用有利于合成的属性。修改后通过连续交互核对响应，而不是只看最终画面，因为单个静态状态无法说明动画是否跟得上用户动作。

title.en: A screen behaves differently on iOS and Android
title.zh: 同一页面在 iOS 与 Android 表现不同

description.en: A screen that differs between iOS and Android needs both sets of screenshots, device sizes, and native settings. Check safe areas, navigation, images, fonts, and platform APIs rather than carrying web-layout assumptions across unchanged. Verify the platform-specific cause and the corrected behavior on each affected side.
description.zh: 同一界面在 iOS 与 Android 表现不同时，提供两端截图、设备尺寸和原生设置。分别检查安全区域、导航、图片、字体及平台 API，避免直接套用网页布局假设。找到平台特有原因后，在受影响的两端核对修改结果。

title.en: Check native dependencies in a monorepo
title.zh: 检查 Monorepo 中的原生依赖

description.en: A React Native application inside a monorepo can depend on packages configured differently across the workspace. Compare native dependency placement and package versions with the Skill’s monorepo rules, then identify mismatches before changing the setup. Keep the proposed correction bounded and verify the affected application under its actual platform configuration rather than assuming that a shared JavaScript package guarantees compatible native dependencies.
description.zh: Monorepo 中的 React Native 应用，可能受到工作区内不同依赖配置影响。对照该 Skill 的规则，检查原生依赖放置位置与包版本，先找出不一致再提出修改。限定修正范围，并在应用真实平台配置下验证，不假定共享 JavaScript 包就能保证原生依赖兼容。

prompt.en: Review this Expo feed screen. Scrolling stutters on mid-range Android devices; identify the likely list and image bottlenecks.
prompt.zh: 检查这个 Expo 信息流页面。中端 Android 设备滚动卡顿，请定位列表和图片方面的可能瓶颈。

description.en: Identify the screen, platform, and interaction that shows the issue. Record your React Native or Expo version and test device.
description.zh: 明确出问题的页面、平台和交互。记录 React Native 或 Expo 版本，以及所用测试设备。

description.en: Ask the agent to inspect the matching list, animation, navigation, or media code. Keep the implementation focused on the reproduced issue.
description.zh: 让 Agent 检查对应的列表、动画、导航或媒体代码。围绕已复现的问题实施修改。

description.en: Repeat the flow on representative iOS and Android devices. Compare responsiveness and confirm gestures, layout, and content remain correct.
description.zh: 在代表性 iOS 与 Android 设备上重复流程。比较响应表现，并确认手势、布局与内容仍然正确。

question.en: Is this for React Native or web React?
question.zh: 这是给 React Native 还是网页 React 用的？

answer.en: It targets React Native and Expo. For browser rendering, the separate Vercel React Best Practices Skill is a closer match.
answer.zh: 它面向 React Native 和 Expo；浏览器端渲染更适合使用单独的 Vercel React Best Practices Skill。

question.en: Will installing the Skill add Expo packages?
question.zh: 安装这个 Skill 会添加 Expo 依赖吗？

answer.en: No. It installs agent instructions. Code or dependency changes require a separate, explicit implementation task.
answer.zh: 不会。安装的是 Agent 指令；修改代码或依赖需要另行执行明确的实现任务。

question.en: Which issue should be checked first?
question.zh: 应该先检查哪类问题？

answer.en: The source puts list performance first. Start there when the symptom is scrolling jank, but follow the actual screen and device evidence.
answer.zh: 原文把列表性能列为最高优先级；滚动卡顿时可先从这里查，但仍以页面和设备证据为准。

question.en: Does it replace device testing?
question.zh: 它能代替真机测试吗？

answer.en: No. Rules help select changes; real iOS and Android testing determines whether the change improves the intended experience.
answer.zh: 不能。规则帮助选择改动；真实 iOS、Android 测试才能判断体验是否改善。

question.en: Why can a list still feel slow after a code review?
question.zh: 代码审查后列表为什么仍然卡顿？

answer.en: Scrolling depends on actual item complexity, image work, and device behavior. Profile a representative long list on target devices; passing a source-code review alone cannot establish smooth interaction.
answer.zh: 滚动还受列表项复杂度、图片处理和实际设备影响。应在目标设备上测试有代表性的长列表，不能仅凭源码审查通过就认为交互流畅。

question.en: Should Android and iOS share every interface decision?
question.zh: Android 与 iOS 的界面决定必须完全相同吗？

answer.en: Share the task and component structure where appropriate, but verify gestures, safe areas, keyboard behavior, and images on both platforms. Native behavior may need platform-specific handling.
answer.zh: 可以复用任务逻辑和组件结构，但手势、安全区域、键盘和图片表现都要在两端验证。必要时应保留符合平台行为的独立处理。

question.en: What project details help the agent choose mobile rules?
question.zh: 哪些项目信息有助于选择移动端规则？

answer.en: Provide React Native and Expo versions, the affected screen, target platforms, and reproduction steps. Note relevant libraries and device measurements, especially for scrolling or animation problems.
answer.zh: 提供 React Native 与 Expo 版本、受影响页面、目标平台和复现步骤。涉及滚动或动画时，也应说明相关库及设备上的测量结果。

cardDescription.en: Apply React Native guidance for mobile lists, gestures, images, and safe areas when building or reviewing native interfaces.
cardDescription.zh: 为 React Native 界面提供移动端指引，覆盖列表、手势、图片处理与安全区域。

en.title: About Vercel React Native Skills
paragraphs: Vercel React Native Skills is an Agent Skill for React Native and Expo development. Its mobile-specific rules address list performance, animation, navigation, interface patterns, state, rendering, monorepos, and configuration. This gives an agent a reference for issues that depend on device rendering or native platform behavior, such as scrolling, gestures, safe areas, and media. Start with a screen and a reproducible symptom so the agent can select the relevant rules and propose a focused implementation. Installing the Skill provides instructions rather than Expo packages or native dependencies. The resulting code still needs to be tested on the iOS and Android environments your application supports.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel React Native Skills
paragraphs: Vercel React Native Skills 是 Vercel Labs 面向 React Native 与 Expo 开发发布的 Agent Skill，整理了列表性能、动画、导航、界面模式、状态、渲染、Monorepo 和配置等移动端规则。对于滚动、手势、安全区域和媒体处理等依赖设备或原生平台的问题，它为 Agent 提供更贴近环境的参考。使用时可以从一个具体页面和可复现现象入手，选择相关规则并提出范围明确的实现建议。安装 Skill 添加的是指令，不会同时安装 Expo 包或原生依赖；最终代码仍需在应用支持的 iOS 与 Android 环境中验证。

title.en: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use React View Transitions by Vercel Labs to plan and implement transitions between React interface states. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 React View Transitions，为 React 界面状态变化设计合适的过渡。围绕卡片进入详情、列表重排和内容加载选择实现方式，让动效表达界面关系，并结合框架配置、浏览器支持与减少动态效果偏好验证体验。

en: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs
zh: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs

title.en: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Vercel React View Transitions by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use React View Transitions by Vercel Labs to plan and implement transitions between React interface states. Connect cards to detail views, preserve identity during list changes, and reveal loaded content with motion that fits the relationship, your framework setup, and users’ reduced-motion preferences.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 React View Transitions，为 React 界面状态变化设计合适的过渡。围绕卡片进入详情、列表重排和内容加载选择实现方式，让动效表达界面关系，并结合框架配置、浏览器支持与减少动态效果偏好验证体验。

summary.en: The source ties animation patterns to spatial meaning. A list-to-detail movement may need a shared element; a background refresh often should not animate at all. Implementation advice is version-sensitive.
summary.zh: 原始指南把动画与空间含义对应起来：列表到详情可能需要共享元素，后台刷新却通常不应动。具体实现还受 React 与框架版本约束。

how.en: How to Implement React View Transitions
how.zh: 如何实现 React 视图过渡

howDescription.en: A view transition begins with the relationship between two interface states, not an animation effect. Check React and framework support before implementation, then review navigation, reduced-motion settings, and usable behavior when animation is absent.
howDescription.zh: 过渡应解释状态之间的关系，不能先选动效再寻找用途。确认 React 和框架支持后，还需检查返回导航、减少动态效果设置及无动画行为，使视觉变化不会妨碍页面使用。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel React View Transitions Skill
title.zh: Vercel React View Transitions Skill的使用场景

description.en: List-to-detail navigation, item reordering, and Suspense reveals communicate different relationships. Compare shared-element identity and refresh behavior before selecting a React transition, including return navigation and the experience when motion is reduced or absent.
description.zh: 共享元素可以说明详情来自哪张卡片，稳定身份可以让排序表现为移动。React 过渡需要围绕这种关系设计，并检查 Suspense 刷新、返回导航及减少动态效果时的体验。

title.en: Open an item from a list

description.en: Opening a detail view from a list can use a named shared element to preserve the relationship with the selected card. Identify the image or title shared by both routes and design the transition around that origin. Check return navigation as well as entry so the visual connection remains understandable in both directions.
description.zh: 从列表打开详情时，可以通过具名共享元素保留它与所选卡片的关系。确定两条路由共用的图片或标题，围绕来源设计过渡，并同时检查进入与返回导航，让使用者在两个方向都能理解页面之间的联系。

description.en: Filtering or sorting a persistent list should communicate rearrangement rather than disappearance and recreation. Check the item IDs and the states before and after the change, then use stable identity for the transition. Existing records should remain recognizable as the same items even when their positions change.
description.zh: 筛选或排序现有列表时，动画应表达位置重排，而不是消失后重新创建。核对条目 ID 及调整前后的状态，通过稳定身份组织过渡。即使位置发生变化，使用者仍应能够辨认它们是原来的记录。

description.en: Content arriving after Suspense can benefit from a restrained reveal, but every refresh does not need the same animation. Inspect boundaries, placeholders, and refresh triggers, then distinguish initial arrival from background updates. Include reduced-motion behavior so the transition rules remain appropriate across user preferences.
description.zh: Suspense 后到达的内容可以使用克制的出现动效，但不需要每次刷新都重复播放。检查边界、占位内容和刷新触发条件，区分首次揭示与后台更新，并考虑减少动态效果的偏好，使过渡规则适合不同使用者。

title.en: Keep the flow usable with reduced motion
title.zh: 保证减少动画时仍然可用

description.en: Navigation and content relationships still need to make sense when a person prefers reduced motion or a transition is unavailable. Compare the animated and non-animated paths, including focus and return navigation, without making motion the only signal that an action succeeded. Record the required behavior first, then treat the visual transition as a supporting part of the interface.
description.zh: 使用者偏好减少动态效果，或过渡不可用时，导航及内容关系仍应清楚。比较有动画和无动画路径，包括焦点与返回导航，不让运动成为动作成功的唯一信号。先记录必要行为，再把视觉过渡作为辅助界面的一部分。

prompt.en: Make this gallery's card-to-detail navigation feel continuous, but leave tab switching and background refresh unobtrusive.
prompt.zh: 让画廊卡片到详情页的切换更连续，但不要让标签切换和后台刷新变得显眼。

description.en: Show the starting and ending views. Identify whether the change is a shared element, list reorder, content reveal, or navigation.
description.zh: 提供起始与结束视图。明确变化属于共享元素、列表重排、内容出现还是导航。

description.en: Check the React and framework prerequisites with the agent. Apply the appropriate transition trigger, element identity, and CSS.
description.zh: 与 Agent 核对 React 和框架前提。应用匹配的触发方式、元素身份与 CSS。

description.en: Check the flow in supported browsers and with reduced motion enabled. Confirm the same action still works without animation.
description.zh: 在支持的浏览器及开启减少动态效果时检查流程。确认关闭动画后，相同操作仍能正常完成。

question.en: Does every route change need a transition?
question.zh: 每次路由变化都需要动画吗？

answer.en: No. The source says transitions should communicate spatial continuity. Unrelated or background changes may be clearer without motion.
answer.zh: 不用。原文强调过渡要说明空间连续性；无关切换或后台变化可能保持静态更清楚。

question.en: Is a third-party animation library required?
question.zh: 必须安装第三方动画库吗？

answer.en: The Skill focuses on React's ViewTransition API and CSS. Whether that API is available depends on your React and framework setup.
answer.zh: 这个 Skill 聚焦 React 的 ViewTransition API 与 CSS；能否使用仍取决于 React 和框架配置。

question.en: What about reduced-motion preferences?
question.zh: 如何处理减少动态效果偏好？

answer.en: Provide a usable no-motion path and test the user's reduced-motion setting; animation must not carry essential information alone.
answer.zh: 需要提供无动画也可用的路径，并测试用户的减少动态效果设置；关键内容不能只靠动画传达。

question.en: Can I use the same recipe in any React app?
question.zh: 所有 React 应用都能用同一套写法吗？

answer.en: No. The source distinguishes Next.js from non-Next.js availability and recommends following its version-specific implementation references.
answer.zh: 不能。原文区分 Next.js 与非 Next.js 的可用条件，应按版本阅读对应实现参考。

question.en: What should happen when a transition cannot run?
question.zh: 视图过渡无法运行时应该怎样降级？

answer.en: The navigation or state change must still work normally. Treat motion as an enhancement and verify that disabling it does not hide content, delay an action, or prevent a user from reaching the next view.
answer.zh: 导航和状态变化仍应正常完成。把动画当作增强效果，关闭动画后也不能隐藏内容、拖延操作或阻止用户进入下一个视图。

question.en: How do I choose a meaningful shared-element transition?
question.zh: 如何判断共享元素过渡是否有意义？

answer.en: Use a visible relationship, such as a selected card becoming its detail view. If the old and new elements are unrelated, a simpler transition or no motion is often easier to understand.
answer.zh: 应有明确的视觉关系，例如选中的卡片进入对应详情。如果前后元素并不相关，简单过渡或不加动画通常更容易理解。

question.en: What should I check before implementing ViewTransition?
question.zh: 实现 ViewTransition 前应检查什么？

answer.en: Confirm the React version, framework configuration, and browser support against the linked source references. Provide the existing route or component and a clear description of the two states you want to connect.
answer.zh: 结合来源中的实现参考核对 React 版本、框架配置和浏览器支持，并提供现有路由或组件，说明需要连接的前后两个状态。

cardDescription.en: Choose React view-transition patterns that connect animation to navigation, shared elements, and meaningful changes in interface state.
cardDescription.zh: 根据导航、共享元素与界面状态变化，选择具有明确空间含义的 React 视图过渡。

en.title: About Vercel React View Transitions
paragraphs: React View Transitions is an Agent Skill published by Vercel Labs for implementing interface transitions with React’s ViewTransition APIs and CSS. It organizes motion around relationships between states: shared elements, arriving content, persistent list items, and navigation. The guidance helps an agent choose what should remain visually connected, when to trigger a transition, and which styles communicate that change. API availability depends on the React and framework setup, so version checks belong before implementation. Use the Skill with a specific transition rather than an open-ended request to animate everything, and verify navigation, reduced-motion behavior, and the fallback when animation cannot run.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel React View Transitions
paragraphs: React View Transitions 是 Vercel Labs 发布的界面过渡 Skill，指导 Agent 使用 React 的 ViewTransition 相关 API 与 CSS 实现状态之间的动效。它围绕共享元素、内容到达、列表条目身份和导航关系组织方案，帮助确定哪些元素应保持视觉连续、何时触发过渡，以及如何表达变化。具体 API 是否可用取决于 React 与框架配置，需要在实现前核对版本。使用时应明确一段具体的界面变化与它要表达的关系，并验证导航、减少动态效果设置，以及无法运行动画时的正常使用路径。

title.en: Web Design Guidelines by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Web Design Guidelines by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use Web Design Guidelines by Vercel Labs to review interface source files against its current Web Interface Guidelines. Give your agent a page or component to inspect, identify issues in interaction and accessibility, and receive findings tied to file and line locations for focused follow-up.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Web Design Guidelines，按当前 Web Interface Guidelines 检查界面源码。向 Agent 指定页面或组件，审查交互与无障碍相关实现，获得带文件和行号的问题列表，便于定位、核对与后续修改。

summary.en: The installed SKILL.md is a short review workflow rather than a frozen rulebook. Its agent fetches the current guideline source for each review, checks the requested files, and returns terse findings.
summary.zh: 安装的 SKILL.md 是简短审查流程，不是固定不变的规则全集。Agent 每次先获取最新规范，再检查指定文件，并输出简洁的问题定位。

how.en: How to Review UI with Web Design Guidelines
how.zh: 如何使用 Web Design Guidelines

howDescription.en: A web-interface review needs selected files and a concrete user flow. Apply the current guidelines within that scope, inspect reported locations in the rendered page, and choose repairs only after confirming the behavior that the finding describes.
howDescription.zh: 界面审阅发现应能够从代码位置回到真实页面。提供指定文件和用户流程，按当前规范检查，再核对渲染行为，确认问题成立后才决定实施范围及需要复测的交互。

title.en: Use Cases for Web Design Guidelines Skill
title.zh: Web Design Guidelines Skill的使用场景

description.en: Keyboard navigation, inconsistent controls, and release reviews expose different interface problems. See how Web Design Guidelines connects interaction behavior with source locations so findings can guide specific repairs and representative checks after implementation.
description.zh: 键盘导航、控件行为不一致和发布前审查会暴露不同界面问题。了解 Web Design Guidelines 如何将交互表现对应到源代码位置，让发现能够指导具体修复及修改后的操作检查。

title.en: A form is hard to navigate by keyboard
title.zh: 表单难以使用键盘操作

description.en: A form that is hard to use by keyboard needs its actual focus path and validation failures inspected in code. Review labels, focus states, error messages, and keyboard handlers together. Tie findings to files and lines so the repair addresses the navigation problem rather than just changing the form's appearance.
description.zh: 键盘难以操作的表单，需要结合代码检查真实焦点路径和验证失败状态。一起审阅标签、焦点样式、错误提示与键盘处理逻辑，将问题定位到文件和行。这样修复针对实际导航障碍，而不只是调整表单外观。

description.en: Similar controls can look aligned while behaving inconsistently. Compare active and navigation states, touch targets, feedback, and interaction semantics across their implementations. Group findings by behavior and recommend how to align them so the review addresses what users can do, not visual taste alone.
description.zh: 相似控件即使外观一致，也可能有不同的操作行为。比较各实现的激活与导航状态、触控目标、反馈和交互语义，按行为类型归纳差异，再提出统一建议。审阅关注使用者实际上能做什么，不只讨论视觉偏好。

title.en: A new page needs a pre-release UI pass
title.zh: 新页面上线前需要 UI 复核

description.en: A pre-release UI review should be bounded by the new page's diff, shared components, and acceptance interactions. Map each finding to the relevant code owner, then check representative interactions after fixes. This keeps the review actionable without silently turning one page's release into a redesign of unrelated screens.
description.zh: 新页面发布前的界面检查，应限定到本次差异、涉及的共享组件和验收交互。将发现对应到相关代码负责人，修复后检查代表性操作。保持结果可执行，也避免把单页发布检查静默扩展成其他页面的重新设计。

title.zh: 检查加载与空状态反馈

description.en: A page needs to explain what is happening when data is delayed, absent, or cannot be submitted. Inspect the relevant states and controls in both code and the rendered interface, checking whether feedback leads to a useful next action. Report concrete locations and behavior instead of prescribing decorative changes that do not address the user's uncertainty.
description.zh: 数据延迟、缺失或无法提交时，页面需要说明当前发生了什么。结合代码和渲染界面检查相关状态与控件，判断反馈能否引导下一步有效行动。报告定位具体行为，不以无法消除用户疑问的装饰调整代替问题修复。

prompt.en: Review the checkout form components against current web interface guidelines. Report only actionable file:line findings.
prompt.zh: 按最新网页界面规范审查结账表单组件，只报告可执行的 file:line 问题。

description.en: Provide page or component paths and describe the interaction to review. Include shared components that affect the selected flow.
description.zh: 提供页面或组件路径，并说明要审查的交互。包含会影响该流程的共享组件。

description.en: Ask the agent to fetch the latest Web Interface Guidelines and inspect the named files. Request findings with file and line locations.
description.zh: 让 Agent 获取最新 Web Interface Guidelines 并检查指定文件。要求问题附带文件与行号。

description.en: Match findings to the rendered UI before editing. Test relevant keyboard, focus, and form behavior after changes.
description.zh: 修改前将发现与实际界面对应。改动后验证相关的键盘、焦点和表单行为。

question.en: Does the Skill contain all web design rules?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 内置了全部网页设计规则吗？

answer.en: No. Its SKILL.md points to a separate, freshly fetched Web Interface Guidelines source.
answer.zh: 没有。SKILL.md 指向另一个网页界面规范来源，并要求每次审查时重新获取。

question.en: Can it review a website URL alone?
question.zh: 只给网址就能审查吗？

answer.en: Its documented workflow reads specified source files. For visual or browser behavior, add a separate rendered-page review.
answer.zh: 原始流程针对指定源码文件。要检查视觉或浏览器行为，还需要另做页面渲染审查。

question.en: What does the result look like?
question.zh: 结果是什么形式？

answer.en: The source asks for terse findings tied to file and line locations, making them easier to verify and fix.
answer.zh: 原文要求用简洁的文件与行号定位问题，便于核对和修复。

question.en: Does a clean review guarantee accessibility?
question.zh: 没有报错就代表无障碍合格吗？

answer.en: No. Assistive-technology and real interaction tests are still needed; file review is one layer.
answer.zh: 不代表。仍需辅助技术和真实交互测试；文件审查只是其中一层。

question.en: Which checks still need hands-on interaction?
question.zh: 哪些检查仍需实际操作？

answer.en: Try keyboard navigation, focus movement, form errors, and layout at narrow widths. Source inspection can identify likely issues, but these interaction checks establish how the interface behaves for a person.
answer.zh: 应亲自验证键盘导航、焦点移动、表单错误和窄屏布局。源码能指出潜在问题，但实际交互才说明用户会遇到什么。

question.en: Should I rerun a review after changing shared components?
question.zh: 改动通用组件后需要重新检查哪些页面？

answer.en: Yes, include representative pages that consume the changed component. A button, dialog, or navigation fix can change behavior across several routes even when only one source file was edited.
answer.zh: 检查使用该组件的代表页面。按钮、对话框或导航只改一个文件，也可能影响多条路由，不能只验证最初发现问题的页面。

question.en: What happens if the agent cannot fetch the guidelines?
question.zh: Agent 无法获取规范时怎么办？

answer.en: The review needs the current guideline source. If it cannot be retrieved, restore access or use a dated copy; results based on that copy cannot establish compliance with later rule changes.
answer.zh: 检查需要当前规范作为依据。无法获取时，可以恢复访问或使用注明日期的副本；副本检查结果不能证明符合之后更新的规则。

cardDescription.en: Review interface files against current web design guidelines and return focused findings tied to the relevant code.
cardDescription.zh: 根据最新网页设计规范审查界面文件，将问题定位到相关代码并给出精简检查结果。

en.title: About Web Design Guidelines
paragraphs: Web Design Guidelines is a review Skill published by Vercel Labs for checking UI source files against Web Interface Guidelines. Its workflow first retrieves the current rules, then reads the files or patterns named by the user and reports located findings. This makes it useful for reviewing a page or shared component before release, especially when you need issues that can be traced back to implementation. The Skill is a review entry point; the guideline document is maintained separately and should be fetched for each review. Source findings should be checked against the rendered interface, with keyboard and assistive-technology testing added where the task requires it.

zh.title: 关于 Web Design Guidelines
paragraphs: Web Design Guidelines 是 Vercel Labs 发布的界面源码审查 Skill，依据 Web Interface Guidelines 检查指定文件。其流程先获取当前规范，再读取用户提供的文件或路径模式，并用文件与行号报告问题，便于将审查结果对应到实际实现。它适合页面上线前复核和共享组件检查，尤其适用于需要明确定位的交互与无障碍问题。Skill 本身是审查入口，规则文档在独立来源维护，每次检查时都应重新获取。源码发现还需要与渲染后的界面核对；涉及键盘或辅助技术体验时，应补充实际操作验证。

title.en: Writing Guidelines by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Writing Guidelines by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use Writing Guidelines by Vercel Labs to review existing documentation and prose against Vercel’s writing handbook. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Writing Guidelines，依据 Vercel 写作手册审查已有文档与文案。指定文件、读者和用途，获取可定位的语言与结构反馈，再结合自己的术语、品牌语气和文档要求，选择适合采纳的修改。

description.en: Use Writing Guidelines by Vercel Labs to review existing documentation and prose against Vercel’s writing handbook. Specify the files, audience, and purpose, then inspect located feedback on language and structure while deciding which suggestions fit your own terminology, brand voice, and documentation requirements.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Writing Guidelines，依据 Vercel 写作手册审查已有文档与文案。指定文件、读者和用途，获取可定位的语言与结构反馈，再结合自己的术语、品牌语气和文档要求，选择适合采纳的修改。

summary.en: The Skill is not a general-purpose copy generator. Its documented workflow retrieves the latest writing guidelines and checks named docs or prose files, with terse file-and-line findings.
summary.zh: 它不是通用文案生成器。原始流程要求获取最新写作规范，检查指定文档或文案文件，并用简洁的文件与行号呈现发现。

how.en: How to Review Docs with Writing Guidelines

howDescription.en: Editing starts with the draft, its reader, and the operation the text should explain. Compare the document with the relevant writing rules, then revise specific passages while preserving verified terminology, technical conditions, and the intended meaning of examples.
howDescription.zh: 读者要完成的操作决定文字怎样组织，原稿和技术条件则限定哪些内容不能随意变化。对照规范修改具体段落时，术语、前提和样例含义仍需与已确认事实保持一致。

title.en: Use Cases for Writing Guidelines Skill

description.en: Tutorials, API references, and release notes answer different reader questions. Compare how Writing Guidelines organizes prerequisites, parameter conditions, and verified user impact without substituting implementation notes or vague promotional language for useful explanations.
description.zh: 教程、API 参考和更新说明需要回答不同的读者问题。了解 Writing Guidelines 如何组织前提条件、参数限制和已验证的用户影响，避免用实施记录或空泛宣传代替有效说明。

title.en: A tutorial is hard to follow

description.en: A tutorial should follow the reader's starting knowledge and the operation they want to complete. Compare headings, steps, examples, and prerequisites with that task rather than the author's implementation history. Revise missing conditions and broken transitions so a reader can continue from one action to the next.
description.zh: 教程应围绕读者已有知识和准备完成的操作展开。将标题、步骤、样例与前提条件逐项对照用户任务，而不是作者的实施历史。修正缺失条件和无法衔接的步骤，让读者能够从一个动作顺利推进到下一个动作。

title.en: An API reference hides key conditions
title.zh: API 参考页埋没了使用条件

description.en: An API reference needs clear names, parameter descriptions, and examples that match confirmed limitations. Review code formatting alongside where conditions and caveats appear, keeping them close to the operations they affect. The revised reference should make usage requirements discoverable before a reader encounters an avoidable error.
description.zh: API 参考需要清楚的命名、参数说明，以及符合已确认限制的样例。审阅代码格式时，同时检查条件与注意事项的位置，让它们靠近真正受影响的操作。使用者应在遇到可避免的错误之前，就能找到必要的使用要求。

description.en: A release note should explain verified behavior changes and their effect on users. Compare the draft with the release diff, replacing vague adjectives and phrases that obscure what changed. Keep unverified claims separate so the published explanation does not promise improvements the evidence cannot establish.
description.zh: 更新说明应讲清已验证的行为变化及其对用户的影响。将草稿与发布差异对照，改写空泛形容和掩盖实际改动的表达。尚未核实的说法单独保留，避免对外说明承诺证据无法支持的改进。

title.zh: 统一关联文档中的术语

description.en: A tutorial, API reference, and release note may describe the same feature with conflicting terms. Compare those expressions against confirmed names and behavior, then propose wording that keeps the reader's understanding consistent. Preserve genuine differences in conditions or meaning rather than making every phrase identical, and do not silently rename code or product concepts during an editorial revision.
description.zh: 教程、API 参考和更新说明，可能用相互冲突的词描述同一功能。对照已确认名称与行为提出修订，让读者理解保持一致，同时保留条件或含义上的真实差别。文字调整不应静默改变代码命名，也不应为了统一表达而消除产品概念区别。

prompt.en: Review these onboarding docs against the current Vercel writing guidelines. Give file:line findings; do not rewrite factual claims.
prompt.zh: 按当前 Vercel 写作规范审查这些入门文档，给出 file:line 问题，不要改写事实陈述。

description.en: Provide the documents or file pattern to review. Include the intended reader, document purpose, and terminology that must be preserved.
description.zh: 提供文档或文件路径模式。说明目标读者、文档用途，以及需要保留的术语。

description.en: Ask the agent to fetch Vercel’s writing handbook and inspect the selected text. Request concise findings with file and line locations.
description.zh: 让 Agent 获取 Vercel 当前写作手册并检查所选文本。要求反馈简洁，并附文件与行号。

description.en: Compare suggestions with your own style requirements before editing. Reread the changed passages for meaning, accuracy, and consistency.
description.zh: 修改前先与自己的文风要求比较。完成后重读相关段落，核对含义、准确性与一致性。

question.en: Is Writing Guidelines a writing generator?
question.zh: Writing Guidelines 是写作生成器吗？

answer.en: No. The documented workflow reviews existing docs or prose and reports issues. Generating new content would need a separate task.
answer.zh: 不是。原始流程审查已有文档或文案并反馈问题；生成新内容需要另行提出任务。

question.en: Where are the rules stored?
question.zh: 规则保存在哪里？

answer.en: The installed SKILL.md points to the separate Vercel writing-handbook source and asks the agent to fetch it fresh for each review.
answer.zh: 安装的 SKILL.md 指向独立的 Vercel 写作手册来源，并要求 Agent 每次审查时重新获取。

question.en: Can I apply it to non-Vercel docs?
question.zh: 非 Vercel 文档可以用吗？

answer.en: You can use it as a review lens, but its style preferences belong to Vercel. Keep your own brand and documentation requirements authoritative.
answer.zh: 可以作为审查视角，但其文风偏好属于 Vercel。你的品牌和文档要求仍应优先。

question.en: What input does it need?
question.zh: 使用时需要提供什么？

answer.en: Provide a file or pattern to review. The original workflow asks for target files if none are specified.
answer.zh: 需要提供待审查文件或路径模式；如果没有指定，原始流程会先询问。

question.en: How should a review preserve an established brand voice?
question.zh: 审查时如何保留已有品牌语气？

answer.en: Provide the intended audience and approved terminology alongside the files. Separate a concrete clarity problem from a stylistic preference, and keep terminology consistent instead of replacing distinctive language mechanically.
answer.zh: 同时提供目标读者和已确认术语，把具体表达问题与风格偏好分开。应保持术语一致，而不是机械替换所有有辨识度的表达。

question.en: What if the current guideline source cannot be retrieved?
question.zh: 无法获取最新规范时还能检查吗？

answer.en: State that the source could not be checked. You can still review obvious spelling or clarity issues, but should not claim that the text passed the latest source-specific rules.
answer.zh: 可以检查明显的拼写或表达问题，但要说明规范未能获取，不能声称文本已经通过最新的一整套规则。

question.en: What should I do when Vercel’s handbook conflicts with our style guide?
question.zh: Vercel 手册与自己的文风规范冲突时怎么办？

answer.en: State which local editorial requirements govern the document and ask the agent to identify conflicts. Use handbook findings as review input, then retain the wording and conventions required by your own documentation.
answer.zh: 先说明这份文档必须遵循的内部编辑要求，让 Agent 标明冲突。将手册意见作为审查参考，再按自己的文档规范决定措辞和格式。

cardDescription.en: Check documentation and interface copy against current writing guidelines, with concise findings linked to files and lines.
cardDescription.zh: 根据最新写作规范检查文档与界面文案，以文件和行号呈现清晰、精简的修改建议。

en.title: About Writing Guidelines
paragraphs: Writing Guidelines is a Vercel Labs Skill for reviewing existing documentation and prose. It retrieves the current Vercel writing handbook, reads specified files, and reports concise findings at file and line locations. The workflow helps an agent connect editorial feedback to the exact text that needs attention, rather than returning a general impression of the document. It suits tutorials, reference pages, and release copy with a defined audience and purpose. The handbook reflects Vercel’s writing preferences, so another team should assess recommendations against its own voice and terminology. Drafting new content or applying edits is a separate task from the documented review.

zh.title: 关于 Writing Guidelines
paragraphs: Writing Guidelines 是 Vercel Labs 面向已有文档与文案发布的审查 Skill。它先获取当前 Vercel 写作手册，再读取指定文件，并以文件和行号给出简洁反馈，让 Agent 将编辑意见对应到具体文本。它适合有明确读者与用途的教程、参考文档和更新说明，帮助检查语言与结构是否服务于阅读任务。写作手册体现的是 Vercel 的表达偏好，其他团队应结合自身品牌语气、术语和文档规范判断建议。原始流程的重点是审查；生成新内容或直接修改文件，需要另外明确任务范围。

title.en: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs to guide an agent through publishing a project to Vercel. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Deploy to Vercel，指导 Agent 将项目部署到 Vercel。先检查仓库关联、账户访问和目标团队，再根据项目状态选择部署方式，默认创建可审阅的预览版本，并在明确需要时处理生产发布。

en: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs
zh: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs

title.en: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use Deploy to Vercel by Vercel Labs to guide an agent through publishing a project to Vercel. Check repository linkage, account access, and the intended team, choose a deployment path that fits the project, and create a preview for review before requesting a production release.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Deploy to Vercel，指导 Agent 将项目部署到 Vercel。先检查仓库关联、账户访问和目标团队，再根据项目状态选择部署方式，默认创建可审阅的预览版本，并在明确需要时处理生产发布。

summary.en: The original workflow starts with read-only checks for Git remote, project linkage, CLI authentication, and teams. It then selects a deployment route. A linked Git project may use a push, but the source requires asking before pushing.
summary.zh: 原始流程先只读检查 Git 远端、项目关联、CLI 登录和团队，再决定部署路径。已关联 Git 的项目可能通过推送部署，但原文要求推送前征得用户同意。

how.en: How to Deploy a Project to Vercel

howDescription.en: A preview deployment needs a confirmed local project and the intended Vercel scope. Check the branch, linked project, and team before execution, then open the resulting URL to inspect pages and assets within the authorized preview task.
howDescription.zh: 预览应来自你准备审阅的分支，并指向正确项目与团队。确认本地关联和授权范围后再执行部署，返回链接还需要打开检查，才能判断页面、素材及关键行为是否符合预期。

title.en: Use Cases for Deploy to Vercel Skill
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel Skill的使用场景

description.en: Preview builds and explicitly requested production releases both need a confirmed project and team. Deploy to Vercel distinguishes those scopes before execution, with local links, authorization, and the returned destination checked against the intended release.
description.zh: 预览构建和明确要求的生产发布，都需要确认目标项目与团队。Deploy to Vercel 区分两类范围，在执行前核对本地关联与授权，并检查返回目标是否对应预期发布。

description.en: A review build needs a known branch, linked project, and authorized preview scope. Request a preview rather than targeting production, then open it to check pages, assets, and key interactions. Share the resulting accessible URL only after verifying that it represents the intended change.
description.zh: 供审阅的构建需要明确分支、关联项目和已授权的预览范围。请求生成预览而不是直接面向生产环境，打开后检查页面、素材和关键交互。确认它确实对应本次变更，再分享可访问的预览链接。

title.en: The local folder may point to the wrong project
title.zh: 本地目录可能关联错项目

description.en: A local folder may carry Vercel links that point somewhere unexpected. Compare existing link files and Git remotes with the intended project identity before running a command that could connect or deploy it. If the identity remains ambiguous, record the mismatch and propose a correction instead of guessing the target.
description.zh: 本地目录可能保留指向其他项目的 Vercel 关联。执行可能连接或部署项目的命令前，将已有链接文件和 Git 远端与目标身份对照。仍有歧义时记录不一致并提出修正方案，不通过猜测决定操作对象。

title.zh: 存在多个 Vercel 团队

description.en: An account with several Vercel teams needs an explicit deployment context. Confirm the intended team or use the linked project's organization ID, then verify the target project within that scope. Keep deployment records tied to the confirmed organization so account availability does not become permission to use an arbitrary team.
description.zh: 账号下有多个 Vercel 团队时，需要明确部署上下文。确认目标团队，或使用关联项目的组织 ID，再核对该范围内的项目。部署记录应对应到已经确认的组织，不能因为账号可以访问多个团队就任意选择其中一个。

title.en: Prepare an explicitly requested production release
title.zh: 准备明确要求的生产发布

description.en: A production deployment requires an explicit request rather than an assumption based on a successful preview. Confirm the intended branch, project, team, and release scope before selecting the documented route, including approval for a Git push where that path requires it. Verify the returned production destination and relevant pages afterward, keeping deployment evidence separate from permission to publish.
description.zh: 生产部署需要明确请求，不能由一次预览成功自动推断。选择原始说明中的路径前，确认分支、项目、团队和发布范围；使用需要推送代码的 Git 路径时，保留相应批准。完成后检查生产目标和相关页面，让部署证据与允许发布的授权分别成立。

prompt.en: Create a Vercel preview for this branch, confirm the linked project and team first, and do not push or deploy production without asking me.
prompt.zh: 为这个分支创建 Vercel 预览，先确认关联的项目和团队；未询问前不要推送或部署生产环境。

description.en: Ask the agent to read the Git remote, local Vercel link, authentication, and team context. Confirm the intended project and environment.
description.zh: 让 Agent 检查 Git 远端、本地 Vercel 关联、认证和团队信息。确认目标项目与环境。

description.en: Use the method that matches the linked repository and available access. Review any proposed Git push before authorizing it.
description.zh: 采用与仓库关联状态及可用访问权限匹配的方法。涉及 Git 推送时，先审阅具体操作再授权。

description.en: Open the returned URL and inspect representative pages. Confirm the project, version, and preview or production destination.
description.zh: 打开返回地址并检查代表页面。核对项目、版本，以及预览或生产环境是否正确。

question.en: What does this Skill install?
question.zh: 安装这个 Skill 会安装什么？

answer.en: It adds agent instructions. You still need appropriate Vercel access and a project that can be built and deployed.
answer.zh: 它添加 Agent 指令。执行部署仍需适当的 Vercel 权限与可构建的项目。

question.en: Is preview deployment the default?
question.zh: 默认是预览部署吗？

answer.en: Yes. The source reserves production for an explicit user request.
answer.zh: 是。原文只在用户明确提出时才走生产部署。

question.en: Does it choose a Vercel team automatically?
question.zh: 它会自动选择 Vercel 团队吗？

answer.en: A linked project can establish the team. If multiple unlinked teams are possible, the workflow asks which one is intended.
answer.zh: 已关联项目可以确定团队；若未关联且有多个可用团队，流程会询问目标团队。

question.en: How is this different from Vercel CLI with Tokens?
question.zh: 它与 Vercel CLI with Tokens 有何不同？

answer.en: Deploy to Vercel is the general deployment-decision workflow. Vercel CLI with Tokens focuses on authenticated CLI operations using an existing access token.
answer.zh: Deploy to Vercel 处理一般的部署决策；Vercel CLI with Tokens 聚焦使用已有访问令牌执行 CLI 操作。

question.en: What should I verify before a deployment can affect production?
question.zh: 可能影响生产环境前需要核对什么？

answer.en: Confirm the intended project, team, branch, and deployment target. Review environment settings and the proposed action, and obtain authorization for a production-changing step before executing it.
answer.zh: 核对项目、团队、分支和部署目标，检查环境配置与准备执行的动作。会改变生产状态的步骤，应在执行前明确获得授权。

question.en: How do I confirm that the intended version is actually live?
question.zh: 怎样确认上线的是预期版本？

answer.en: Check the deployment result and the URL that serves the intended environment. Compare the revision and representative page behavior; a completed upload alone does not prove that production traffic uses it.
answer.zh: 检查部署结果及对应环境的访问地址，核对版本和代表页面行为。文件上传成功本身不能证明生产流量已切换到这次版本。

question.en: Will the Skill push code without asking?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 会不询问就推送代码吗？

answer.en: The source’s linked-Git deployment path explicitly requires approval before pushing. Review the target branch and project first, since a push may trigger the repository’s configured deployment workflow.
answer.zh: 原始说明中的已关联 Git 部署路径要求推送前获得授权。应先核对目标分支和项目，因为推送可能触发仓库已配置的部署流程。

cardDescription.en: Prepare a Vercel deployment by checking project linkage, CLI access, and team context before choosing an authorized deployment route.
cardDescription.zh: 检查 Vercel 项目关联、CLI 登录和团队信息，在获得授权后选择合适的部署方式。

en.title: About Deploy to Vercel
paragraphs: Deploy to Vercel is a Vercel Labs Skill that guides an agent through selecting and carrying out a deployment workflow. It starts by checking the Git remote, local Vercel project linkage, CLI authentication, and available teams. Those checks establish the intended destination before the agent chooses a linked Git or another supported deployment route. The source defaults to preview deployments unless production is explicitly requested and requires approval before pushing code through its Git path. Installing the Skill supplies workflow instructions; a deployable project and the required account access are still needed. After deployment, verify the returned URL and project rather than treating an upload as proof of the intended result.

zh.title: 关于 Deploy to Vercel
paragraphs: Deploy to Vercel 是 Vercel Labs 发布的部署流程 Skill，指导 Agent 根据项目当前状态选择并执行 Vercel 部署。流程先检查 Git 远端、本地 Vercel 关联、CLI 认证和可用团队，确认目标后再选择已关联 Git 或其他受支持的部署路径。原始说明默认创建预览，只有用户明确要求时才进行生产部署；走 Git 推送路径时，也需要先获得授权。安装 Skill 提供的是流程指引，实际部署仍需可构建项目及相应账户访问。完成后应核对返回地址、所属项目和页面表现，确认得到的是预期环境与版本。

title.en: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs to guide deployment and project management with token-based authentication. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel CLI with Tokens，通过令牌认证指导部署与项目管理。先确认已授权的凭据来源和目标项目、团队，再执行对应 CLI 任务，适用于不依赖交互登录的工作环境，并避免在报告中暴露令牌值。

en: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs
zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs

title.en: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs
title.zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs

description.en: Use Vercel CLI with Tokens by Vercel Labs to guide deployment and project management with token-based authentication. Identify the approved credential source, confirm the project and team, and carry out the requested CLI task without depending on an interactive login or exposing token values in reports.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel CLI with Tokens，通过令牌认证指导部署与项目管理。先确认已授权的凭据来源和目标项目、团队，再执行对应 CLI 任务，适用于不依赖交互登录的工作环境，并避免在报告中暴露令牌值。

summary.en: The source first checks where the token and project identifiers come from. It warns against placing tokens in command-line arguments and distinguishes authentication from knowing which project and organization a command will affect.
summary.zh: 原始流程先确认令牌和项目标识的来源，明确警告不要把令牌写在命令行参数中，并区分“已认证”和“知道命令会影响哪个项目及组织”。

kind.zh: 已认证 CLI 工作流 Skill

how.en: How to Use Vercel CLI with Tokens
how.zh: 如何使用令牌操作 Vercel CLI

howDescription.en: Token-based CLI work requires an approved credential reference and a verified project identity. The sequence below establishes that context before invoking Vercel commands, then checks results without placing token values in copied commands or reports.
howDescription.zh: 认证成功不等于项目选择正确。Vercel 命令需要同时对应已批准的凭据引用和目标组织，执行后检查作用范围与结果，并保证 token 值不出现在复制命令或报告里。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill
title.zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill的使用场景

description.en: Background tasks, broad token access, and existing scripts need explicit credential boundaries. Explore how Vercel CLI with Tokens separates authentication from project selection and avoids exposing secret values through commands, logs, or review material.
description.zh: 后台任务和多项目访问需要明确凭据边界。了解 Vercel CLI with Tokens 如何区分认证与项目选择，并避免在命令、日志和审阅材料中暴露密钥。

title.en: A non-interactive environment needs Vercel access
title.zh: 非交互环境需要 Vercel 权限

description.en: A non-interactive task can use an existing secret-managed token instead of depending on a browser login session. Confirm the target project and approved credential reference, then construct a repeatable authenticated invocation. Keep token values out of logs and reports while checking that the command reaches the intended scope.
description.zh: 非交互任务可以使用已由密钥系统管理的 token，无需依赖浏览器登录会话。先确认目标项目和批准的凭据引用，再组织可重复执行的认证调用。检查命令作用范围的同时，确保日志与报告中不出现 token 值。

title.en: One token can reach multiple projects
title.zh: 一个令牌可访问多个项目

description.en: A token that reaches several projects does not determine which one a change should affect. Verify the project and organization identifiers before editing environment variables or deploying, and compare the result with that target. Broad credential access must not substitute for an explicit project-level decision.
description.zh: token 能访问多个项目，并不能决定本次应该修改哪一个。调整环境变量或部署前，先核对项目和组织标识，再将结果与目标对照。凭据拥有较广范围，不代表可以省略明确的项目选择。

title.en: A command could expose a secret

description.en: Credential handling should be reviewed in the scripts, logging settings, and places where values are passed. Replace pasted tokens with the approved environment mechanism and inspect possible exposure through commands, logs, or review comments. Check the revised path afterward so removing one visible value does not leave another disclosure route behind.
description.zh: 检查凭据处理时，需要同时查看脚本、日志设置和传值位置。将粘贴的 token 替换为批准的环境引用方式，排查命令、日志和审阅评论中的泄露路径。调整后再次核对，避免只清除一个可见值，却留下其他暴露入口。

title.zh: 排查认证成功后的访问问题

description.en: A command may authenticate successfully yet fail for the intended project or operation. Compare the observed response with the confirmed project, organization, and approved credential scope without exposing the token value. Identify which condition remains unverified and propose the next check, rather than widening access or switching targets simply to make the command succeed.
description.zh: 命令可能通过身份认证，却无法操作目标项目。将实际响应与已确认的项目、组织和批准凭据范围对照，同时不暴露 token 值。说明哪项条件仍未验证并提出下一检查，不为让命令成功就扩大权限或任意更换目标。

prompt.en: Use the approved Vercel token to inspect this project's environment settings. Confirm project and team IDs first; never print the token.
prompt.zh: 使用已批准的 Vercel 令牌检查这个项目的环境设置，先核对项目和团队 ID，绝不要输出令牌。

description.en: Identify the approved environment or secret store used for authentication. Keep the token value out of prompts, copied commands, and reports.
description.zh: 确认认证使用的已授权环境或密钥存储。不要把令牌值写入提示词、复制的命令或报告。

description.en: Check project identifiers and team scope before any change. Compare them with the Vercel project the user intends to manage.
description.zh: 任何变更前先核对项目标识与团队范围。将其与用户希望管理的 Vercel 项目对应。

description.en: Ask the agent to carry out the requested CLI task in the confirmed scope. Verify the result without including secrets in logs or summaries.
description.zh: 让 Agent 在已确认范围内完成请求的 CLI 任务。核对结果，避免日志或总结包含密钥。

question.en: Does the Skill give me a Vercel token?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 会提供 Vercel 令牌吗？

answer.en: No. It guides use of an existing, authorized token. Creating or granting access is separate account work.
answer.zh: 不会。它指导使用已有且获授权的令牌；创建令牌或授予权限属于另一个账户操作。

question.en: Can I paste a token into the prompt?
question.zh: 可以把令牌粘贴到提示词里吗？

answer.en: Avoid it. Use your approved secret-management environment and keep token values out of chat, commands, and reports.
answer.zh: 应避免。通过获批准的密钥管理环境使用，并让令牌值远离聊天、命令和报告。

question.en: Why check both project and organization?
question.zh: 为什么项目与组织都要确认？

answer.en: A valid token may cover multiple scopes. Authentication alone does not prove that a CLI command points to the intended project.
answer.zh: 有效令牌可能覆盖多个范围；认证成功不能证明命令指向了目标项目。

question.en: Is interactive login required?
question.zh: 必须交互登录吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill is specifically for token-based CLI work instead of depending on an interactive vercel login session.
answer.zh: 不必。这个 Skill 专门用于令牌式 CLI 操作，不依赖交互式 vercel login。

question.en: Where should a CI job obtain its token?
question.zh: CI 任务应从哪里获取令牌？

answer.en: Use the CI platform’s secret storage and expose the credential only to the authorized job. Keep it out of source files, printed commands, generated artifacts, and copied troubleshooting logs.
answer.zh: 通过 CI 平台的密钥存储提供给获授权的任务，不把令牌写进源码、打印的命令、构建产物或复制出的排错日志。

question.en: What should I do if a token may have leaked?
question.zh: 怀疑令牌泄露后应该怎么办？

answer.en: Revoke the exposed credential and replace it through the account’s normal credential controls. Update the affected secret store and check which project actions may have used the old token.
answer.zh: 通过账号的凭据管理撤销旧令牌并替换，更新相关密钥存储，同时检查旧令牌可能执行过哪些项目操作。

question.en: How do I check that the CLI operation used the intended project?
question.zh: 如何检查 CLI 操作是否作用于预期项目？

answer.en: Compare the resolved project and organization identifiers with your known Vercel project before the operation. Afterward, verify the deployment or configuration in that same project rather than relying on authentication success alone.
answer.zh: 操作前将解析出的项目和组织标识与已知 Vercel 项目对应，完成后在同一项目核对部署或配置。不能仅凭认证成功判断目标正确。

cardDescription.en: Use Vercel CLI token workflows with explicit project context and careful handling of credentials and organization identifiers.
cardDescription.zh: 为 Vercel CLI 令牌流程明确项目与组织上下文，规范凭据来源及敏感信息处理。

en.title: About Vercel CLI with Tokens
paragraphs: Vercel CLI with Tokens is an Agent Skill for Vercel CLI work where an access token is the chosen authentication method. It guides the agent to locate the existing credential source, resolve project and organization identifiers, and perform the requested deployment or management task in the intended scope. This is useful in non-interactive environments or when project access is supplied through managed secrets. Authentication alone does not identify which project an action should affect. The source also warns against putting tokens in command-line arguments. Installing the Skill does not create a token or grant access; those remain account and environment prerequisites.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel CLI with Tokens
paragraphs: Vercel CLI with Tokens 是 Vercel Labs 面向令牌式 Vercel CLI 操作发布的 Agent Skill。它指导 Agent 确认已有凭据来源，解析项目与组织标识，再在目标范围内完成部署或管理任务，适用于非交互环境或通过密钥管理系统提供访问的工作流程。认证成功并不能单独确定操作对象，因此项目与团队需要分别核对。原始说明也提醒不要将令牌放进命令行参数。安装 Skill 不会生成令牌或授予账户访问；这些仍是账户与环境的前提，具体使用应避免在聊天、日志和报告中暴露凭据值。

title.en: Vercel Optimize by Vercel Labs | Installation & Guide
title.zh: Vercel Optimize by Vercel Labs：安装与使用指南

description.en: Use Vercel Optimize by Vercel Labs to investigate cost and performance in a deployed Vercel project. Explore use cases, installation options, and a practical usage guide.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel Optimize，调查已部署 Vercel 项目的成本与性能。先收集用量与生产信号，再确定有证据支持的路由和设置，结合框架版本、相关源码与可观测性权限，形成有优先级的改进建议。

description.en: Use Vercel Optimize by Vercel Labs to investigate cost and performance in a deployed Vercel project. Start with usage and production signals, identify routes or settings supported by evidence, and review prioritized recommendations tied to the project’s framework, source files, and available observability access.
description.zh: 使用 Vercel Labs 的 Vercel Optimize，调查已部署 Vercel 项目的成本与性能。先收集用量与生产信号，再确定有证据支持的路由和设置，结合框架版本、相关源码与可观测性权限，形成有优先级的改进建议。

summary.en: The source prescribes an observability-first audit, not a repository-wide optimization sweep. Its scripts collect and merge Vercel signals, gate investigations, and produce ranked recommendations; route-level advice depends on access and observability prerequisites.
summary.zh: 原始流程强调可观测性优先，而非全仓库随意扫一遍。它用脚本汇总 Vercel 信号、筛选调查对象并排序建议；路由级结论依赖相应权限和可观测性前提。

kind.zh: 带脚本的指标驱动审查 Skill

how.en: How to Audit a Project with Vercel Optimize

howDescription.en: Optimization begins with the measured usage or route behavior that needs an explanation. Follow the evidence into relevant source and settings, compare proposed changes with freshness constraints, and repeat the measurements before accepting a cost or latency improvement.
howDescription.zh: 成本或延迟的解释应能沿测量追溯到路由、源文件和设置。比较修改方案时同时考虑内容时效，实施后重新测量，才能区分真实改善、环境波动和缓存带来的过期结果。

title.en: Use Cases for Vercel Optimize Skill

description.en: Usage increases, costly routes, and cache proposals need measured evidence before an optimization choice. Compare how Vercel Optimize links billing periods and route signals to source changes while retaining content-freshness and invalidation requirements.
description.zh: 使用量增加、路由成本和缓存提案，需要先获得测量依据再选择优化。了解 Vercel Optimize 如何连接计费周期、路由信号与代码变更，并保留内容时效和缓存失效要求。

description.en: An unexpected rise in function usage needs a comparable billing period and route-level metrics before attributing cost to one endpoint or cache setting. Connect the observed usage to its source and rank optimization candidates by evidence. The explanation should distinguish measured contributors from plausible but untested causes.
description.zh: 函数使用量意外增加时，先确定可比计费周期并查看路由指标，再判断某个端点或缓存设置是否导致变化。将观测到的使用量对应到来源，依据证据排列优化优先级。成本解释要区分已测量的贡献和仍待验证的可能原因。

title.en: One page seems expensive or slow
title.zh: 某个页面似乎既慢又贵

description.en: A page that seems slow or expensive should be investigated through its route signals, performance traces, and deployment versions. Let those measurements identify relevant source files and settings, then make a change that can be measured again. Preserve the path from metric to code so the optimization has a checkable basis.
description.zh: 页面看起来慢或成本高时，结合路由信号、性能记录和部署版本调查。让测量结果指向需要检查的源文件与设置，再实施能够重新测量的修改。保留指标到代码的对应链路，使优化建立在可以复核的依据上。

title.en: A cache change is being proposed

description.en: A cache proposal must account for current hit patterns, framework behavior, and the content's freshness requirements. Compare ISR, middleware, or response-cache changes only after those conditions are understood. Explain invalidation risks and recheck both cache hits and content updates so lower usage does not hide stale results.
description.zh: 提出缓存调整前，需要了解当前命中情况、框架行为和内容时效要求，再比较 ISR、中间件或响应缓存等修改。说明失效风险，并同时检查命中与内容更新结果，避免使用量降低的同时产生过期内容。

title.en: Establish a baseline for the next change
title.zh: 为下一次优化建立基线

description.en: Before accepting a proposed optimization, agree on the route, time window, workload, and freshness conditions that will be compared. Retain the current measurements and link them to the relevant deployment. The later review can then judge whether cost or latency changed under comparable conditions, rather than attributing every movement in the dashboard to the most recent code edit.
description.zh: 接受优化方案前，先约定将要比较的路由、时间窗口、工作负载和时效条件，保留当前测量并关联到相关部署。后续审阅才能判断成本或延迟是否在可比条件下变化，而不是把看板上的每次波动都归因于最近一次代码修改。

prompt.en: Investigate last month's Vercel function-cost increase. Confirm the project scope, use available metrics, and rank only evidence-backed opportunities.
prompt.zh: 调查上个月 Vercel 函数成本上涨。先确认项目范围，读取可用指标，只排序有证据支持的优化机会。

description.en: Confirm the linked Vercel project, account, and framework. Check the source’s CLI, Node, and observability requirements before collecting signals.
description.zh: 确认关联的 Vercel 项目、账户和框架。采集信号前核对原始说明中的 CLI、Node 与可观测性要求。

description.en: Use the bundled collection workflow to gather production signals. Let its gate identify candidates before investigating source files.
description.zh: 使用附带流程收集生产信号。先通过筛选确定候选项，再调查源码文件。

description.en: Inspect only the selected routes or settings with the agent. Review evidence, framework-version fit, and a validation plan for each proposed change.
description.zh: 与 Agent 仅检查选定路由或设置。逐项核对证据、框架版本适配和改动后的验证方式。

question.en: Does Vercel Optimize scan the entire repository first?
question.zh: Vercel Optimize 会先扫描整个仓库吗？

answer.en: No. Its documented doctrine collects production signals first and gates code investigation to metric-backed candidates.
answer.zh: 不会。原始原则先收集生产信号，再把代码调查限定在有指标支持的候选项。

question.en: Can it estimate savings without Observability Plus?
question.zh: 没有 Observability Plus 能估算节省金额吗？

answer.en: Route-level metric-backed recommendations require the stated observability access. Missing data should be reported as a limitation, not replaced with invented precision.
answer.zh: 路由级指标建议依赖原文要求的可观测性权限。缺少数据应明确说明，不能用虚构的精确数字代替。

question.en: Which frameworks does it address?
question.zh: 它适用于哪些框架？

answer.en: The source lists strong support for Next.js, support for SvelteKit and Nuxt, limited Astro support, and a restricted path for others. Check the current source before running an audit.
answer.zh: 原文对 Next.js 支持最完整，也支持 SvelteKit、Nuxt；Astro 有限，其他框架需要受限流程。运行前应核对当前来源。

question.en: Is it only a prose checklist?
question.zh: 它只是文字检查清单吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill bundles scripts and references for signal collection, gating, and report generation. Those still depend on authorized Vercel access.
answer.zh: 不是。它带有信号收集、筛选和报告所需的脚本及参考资料，但仍依赖已授权的 Vercel 访问。

question.en: What evidence is useful before starting an optimization review?
question.zh: 开始优化前准备哪些证据最有帮助？

answer.en: Provide the affected routes, a representative time window, and available latency, error, or resource signals. A concrete baseline makes recommendations more useful than a broad request to reduce every possible cost.
answer.zh: 提供受影响路由、有代表性的时间窗口，以及可用的延迟、错误或资源信号。具体基线比笼统要求降低所有成本更有助于形成有效建议。

question.en: How should I validate a proposed optimization?
question.zh: 怎样验证优化建议是否有效？

answer.en: Compare the same workload before and after the change and check correctness as well as performance. A lower resource figure is not an improvement if errors increase or the user’s task stops working.
answer.zh: 在相同负载下比较修改前后，同时检查正确性和性能。如果资源数字下降却增加错误或破坏任务，就不能算有效优化。

question.en: What prerequisites should I check before running Vercel Optimize?
question.zh: 运行 Vercel Optimize 前应核对哪些条件？

answer.en: The source lists Vercel CLI v53+, Node.js 20+, an authenticated CLI, and a linked project with the intended account scope. Route-level metric-backed recommendations require Observability Plus. Confirm the current source requirements before running its scripts.

en.title: About Vercel Optimize
paragraphs: Vercel Optimize is a Vercel Labs Skill for investigating deployed-project cost and performance using production evidence. Its bundled scripts collect signals and select candidates before the agent reads the related source files. This keeps recommendations tied to observed routes and settings rather than a broad search for suspicious code. The source describes framework-specific support for Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt, and limited Astro use. It requires a linked project, suitable CLI and Node versions, and the intended account scope; route-level metric-backed advice also needs Observability Plus. The workflow produces ranked recommendations, whose effects should be checked against the same workload after any implementation.

zh.title: 关于 Vercel Optimize
paragraphs: Vercel Optimize 是 Vercel Labs 面向已部署项目成本与性能调查发布的 Skill，强调先看生产证据，再阅读相关源码。它附带收集信号和筛选候选项的脚本，让建议对应到有指标支持的路由或设置，避免仅凭可疑代码推断优化收益。原始说明列出了 Next.js、SvelteKit、Nuxt 与有限的 Astro 支持，并要求项目关联、合适的 CLI 和 Node 版本及正确账户范围；路由级指标建议还需要 Observability Plus。流程最终形成按优先级整理的建议，实施后仍应在相同负载下比较表现与正确性。

how.en: How to Use the agent-browser Skill

howDescription.en: Browser work needs the correct CLI guidance and an allowed target before interaction begins. Establish the session, observe current controls, and verify results after actions, using specialist instructions when the task concerns exploratory testing or an Electron application.
howDescription.zh: 浏览器动作要基于当前观察，而不是先前记住的位置。准备允许的目标和适用 CLI 指引后再交互，并核对动作结果；探索测试与 Electron 应用还需各自的专门配置。

description.en: Live web flows, exploratory reproductions, and Electron applications need different session setup. Compare the core CLI workflow and specialist guidance while keeping permitted scope, observed controls, and actual page evidence attached to each interaction.
description.zh: 测试线上流程需要获准会话，探索故障需要限定范围，Electron 应用则有专门连接方式。agent-browser 任务应按目标选择指引，并用当前控件和页面证据验证交互。

title.en: An agent must inspect a live flow
title.zh: Agent 需要检查真实网页流程

description.en: Inspecting a live flow requires a permitted session, test URL, and expected interaction path. Read the CLI's core workflow before navigating or taking control snapshots, then record actual page states as the flow proceeds. Evidence should identify where behavior fails rather than merely show that a page could be opened.
description.zh: 检查线上流程需要允许使用的会话、测试地址和预期操作路径。导航或获取控件快照前，先阅读 CLI 核心流程，再随操作记录实际页面状态。证据应指出行为在哪一步失败，而不只是证明某个页面能够打开。

description.en: Exploratory reproduction needs a suspect feature, useful clues, and a bounded testing scope. Follow the specialist dogfood workflow referenced by the stub, then organize findings by reproduction conditions, page evidence, and impact. Keep exploration within the approved area so quality review does not become uncontrolled interaction with unrelated features.
description.zh: 探索性复现需要明确可疑功能、已有线索和允许检查的范围。沿入口指引阅读专门的 dogfood 流程，再按复现条件、页面证据和影响组织发现。保持探索边界，避免质量检查变成对无关功能的无范围操作。

title.en: The target is an Electron app

description.en: An Electron target needs its application entry point, intended window, and the interactions to inspect established first. Use the CLI's dedicated Electron guidance to select the app-specific connection method. Verify behavior through that route rather than assuming an ordinary browser session controls the intended application window.
description.zh: 目标是 Electron 应用时，先确认应用入口、目标窗口和待检查交互，按照 CLI 的专门指引选择对应连接方式。通过这条应用路径验证行为，不假定普通浏览器会话已经控制了真正需要检查的窗口。

title.zh: 核对表单保存后的结果

description.en: A permitted form task should be checked after entry, not just after a click or a successful command response. Observe the current controls, submit only within the authorized test scope, and read back the displayed or saved values. If the page state changes, obtain fresh evidence before continuing so stale element references do not cause an action on the wrong record.
description.zh: 已获准的表单任务，需要在录入后核对，不能只看点击或命令是否成功。观察当前控件，在授权测试范围内提交，再读回显示或保存的数值。页面变化后重新获取证据，避免沿过期元素引用继续，导致操作落在错误记录上。

prompt.en: Use agent-browser to test the sign-in flow. Load the current core instructions first, then report the exact step that fails.
prompt.zh: 用 agent-browser 测试登录流程。先加载当前核心指引，再报告具体在哪一步失败。

question.en: Does installing the Skill install the browser CLI?
question.zh: 安装 Skill 会同时安装浏览器 CLI 吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill adds a short instruction stub. The agent-browser CLI and browser setup are separate installations.
answer.zh: 不会。Skill 只添加精简指令入口；agent-browser CLI 和浏览器环境需要单独安装。

question.en: Where are the full browser instructions?
question.zh: 完整浏览器指令在哪里？

answer.en: The installed CLI serves them through `agent-browser skills get core` and specialist workflows such as `dogfood` or `electron`.
answer.zh: 已安装 CLI 通过 `agent-browser skills get core` 以及 `dogfood`、`electron` 等专项流程提供。

question.en: Why does the repository look like a tool?
question.zh: 为什么这个仓库看起来像工具？

answer.en: Because it is primarily a CLI tool. The SKILL.md is a companion component for AI agents; the two should not be classified as the same deliverable.
answer.zh: 因为它的主体确实是 CLI 工具；SKILL.md 只是供 AI Agent 使用的配套组件，两者不应被当作同一种交付物。

question.en: Can the Skill run a browser by itself?
question.zh: 单靠这个 Skill 能操作浏览器吗？

answer.en: No. The CLI performs navigation, snapshots, and interactions. The Skill tells the agent which CLI-served workflow to read first.
answer.zh: 不能。导航、快照和交互由 CLI 执行；Skill 只告诉 Agent 先读取哪一份由 CLI 提供的流程。

question.en: Why can a browser instruction stop matching the page?
question.zh: 浏览器指令为什么会突然找不到页面元素？

answer.en: Navigation and dynamic updates can replace controls or change page state. Inspect the current page again and retarget the action rather than repeating a stale element reference.
answer.zh: 导航和动态更新可能替换控件或改变页面状态。应重新检查当前页面再选择目标，不要反复使用已经过时的元素引用。

question.en: Can an agent submit any form once the browser is connected?
question.zh: 连接浏览器后 Agent 就能提交任何表单吗？

answer.en: Browser access does not establish permission for every action. Confirm the user’s intended destination and action before sending messages, publishing material, purchasing, or changing account access.
answer.zh: 能操作浏览器不代表获得了所有动作的授权。发送消息、发布内容、购买或改变账号访问权限前，仍需确认用户授权的目标与操作。

question.en: How do I prepare the CLI separately from the Skill?
question.zh: 如何单独准备 CLI，而不是只安装 Skill？

answer.en: Follow the repository’s tool setup instructions. Its entry file lists npm i -g agent-browser followed by agent-browser install for the tool and browser setup. Then load agent-browser skills get core before browser tasks; check upstream requirements for your platform.
answer.zh: 按仓库的工具安装说明准备环境。入口文件列出 npm i -g agent-browser 和 agent-browser install，分别用于工具与浏览器设置。开始任务前读取 agent-browser skills get core，并核对上游的平台要求。

en.title: About agent-browser Skill
paragraphs: The agent-browser Skill is a companion instruction published by Vercel Labs for the agent-browser browser-automation CLI. Its short entry file directs the agent to load core or specialized workflows from the installed CLI, keeping detailed instructions aligned with the tool version. Core guidance supports website interaction, while specialized entries address tasks such as exploratory testing and Electron applications. The Skill and CLI have separate roles: installing the instruction does not install the tool or its browser dependencies. Prepare those through the upstream setup guide, then load the matching workflow before acting on a page. Review the current page state and verify the result of each task.

zh.title: 关于 agent-browser Skill
